changelog:
Initial release of SupplyFlow — a manufacturing supply chain management toolkit.

- Supports inventory tracking, supplier evaluation, procurement workflows, demand forecasting, risk assessment, and cost optimization.
- Freemium model: Free tier includes inventory tracking, basic supplier evaluation, and purchase order templates; paid tier unlocks forecasting, risk, optimization, and performance reports.
- Triggered by keywords related to inventory, supplier, procurement, forecasting, risk, and cost in both Chinese and English.
- Scripts process JSON input and output markdown tables plus analysis, with free scripts providing basic analysis and paid scripts offering deeper insights.
- All functions run locally with no external API dependencies.
